purpose: the keyword stopword list (src/fts-query.js STOPWORDS) and the candidate v2 list
notes: `v2` is candidate stopwords-v2: `current` plus `v2Additions`. It is not in force; it would go in only through the eval gate.
`intro` and `introductory` go to the level intent parser, never the stopword list.
The code-join guard ('letters on the collision or stopword list') reads the stopword list in force. No v2 addition is a corpus prefix, so the guard is the same under `current` and `v2`.
